business_profile.business_overview: Tech Dental Care is Bangladesh's largest dental chain, operating 4 branches in Dhaka (Mirpur, Uttara, Badda, Jatrabari) with advanced technology — painless dentistry, intraoral cameras, RVG digital imaging. They offer the full spectrum from scaling (৳1,990) and fillings (৳3,000) to root canals (৳8,000), braces (৳50,000+), implants (৳60,000-80,000), Invisalign (৳180,000), and digital smile design. They already run a 'Treatment Price Calculator' and a 'Request a Free Callback' form on their site, plus a WhatsApp line (+8801400786162) and hotline (09638-000505). High patient volume across 4 locations with intake that still depends on callbacks.
business_profile.offer_surface: Autonomous AI agent deployment for Dental clinic chain — targeting: Multi-branch appointment booking with real-time slot confirmation and doctor routing; Treatment enquiry qualification (implants vs braces vs cosmetic) with instant price guidance; Patient follow-up and recall automation (6-month checkup reminders, post-op check-ins); Callback-to-booking conversion agent that eliminates the wait-for-callback gap

business_profile.competitive_position: Tech Dental is the market leader by scale (largest chain, 4 branches, advanced tech). Their vulnerability is intake friction: a callback model in an era where patients expect instant booking. Competitors like Laser Dental (Banani/Uttara) compete on premium cosmetic positioning. An AI agent that books real-time slots, connects the price calculator to appointments, and automates recall would make the largest chain also the most responsive — defending its lead.
business_profile.opportunity_size: Across 4 branches with treatments from ৳1,990 to ৳180,000, patient volume is high and lifetime value is significant (recurring scaling, checkups, staged treatments). If the callback model and manual routing lose even a fraction of enquiries — and if the large existing patient base isn't recalled automatically — that's substantial recurring revenue leakage. An AI booking + recall agent recovers new-patient leakage AND reactivates dormant patients.
business_profile.how_the_agent_helps:
1. AI booking agent that offers real-time slots at the right branch and books instantly — no callback wait.
2. Price-calculator-to-booking agent that follows up every treatment-price estimate with an instant booking option.
3. Recall agent that sends 6-month checkup and post-op follow-up reminders automatically.
4. Multi-branch routing agent that directs each patient to the correct location and specialist.
business_profile.demo_scenario: A patient in Uttara uses Tech Dental's Treatment Price Calculator at 10pm for a root canal (৳8,000). In seconds the AI replies: 'A root canal starts at ৳8,000. I can book you at our Uttara branch — Dr. [X] has slots tomorrow at 11am or 4pm. Which works?' The patient picks 11am; it's booked with a reminder set. No callback wait, and a 6-month recall is already scheduled. Tech Dental converted a price lookup into a booked patient while they slept.
